core_values.name: cultural_identity
core_values.desc: preserve national traditions, patriotism, and religion in public life

core_values.name: popular_will
core_values.desc: legitimacy flows from ordinary citizens, not elites

key_definitions.definition: a political community rooted in shared culture, language, history, and citizenship
arises from direct representation of the people rather than elite institutions
movement that must be tightly controlled to preserve national security and culture
entrenched media, academic, or governmental actors viewed as out of touch or corrupt
ability of citizens to speak and act without elite suppression; balanced by loyalty to nation

assumed_principles.name: priority_of_citizens
assumed_principles.desc: citizens’ interests come before those of foreigners or global bodies

assumed_principles.name: skepticism_of_elites
assumed_principles.desc: elites act in self-interest, not the public’s

assumed_principles.name: patriotic_duty
assumed_principles.desc: citizens owe loyalty and defense of their nation

assumed_principles.name: mobilization_legitimacy
assumed_principles.desc: mass rallies and direct speech are authentic expressions of democracy

warrants.name: globalization_harm
warrants.desc: offshoring and open borders weaken workers and culture

warrants.name: media_power
warrants.desc: mainstream media shapes narratives hostile to populists

decision_rule.notes: Arguments judged by how well they defend national identity and resist elite/global pressures.

policy_heuristics.default: defend ally speech; confront perceived institutional bias
promote fossil fuels and energy independence over climate goals

edge_cases.note: broad state power acceptable if aligned with national defense
support allies only if clearly advancing national interest
acceptable when framed as rewarding service (veterans, law enforcement)

metadata.author: TruthSplit Team
metadata.note: Neutral analytic profile of a populist-nationalist (MAGA-style) worldview; not an endorsement.
